title: Comultiplication expansion in a prescribed finite basis
statement: Let k be a field, H a commutative Hopf k-algebra with comultiplication Δ, V a k-subspace of H, n a natural number, and b a basis of V indexed by Fin n. Write v_i for the image of b_i in H. Assume that Δ(x) belongs to span_k{a⊗y | a∈V, y∈H} for every x∈V. Then there exists c : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) H such that Δ(v_j)=∑_i v_i⊗c_ij for every j∈Fin n. All tensor products are over k.
lean_statement: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] {H : Type*} [CommRing H] [HopfAlgebra k H] (V : Submodule k H) (n : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) k V) (hV : ∀ x ∈ V, Coalgebra.comul (R := k) x ∈ Submodule.span k {t : TensorProduct k H H | ∃ a ∈ V, ∃ y : H, t = TensorProduct.tmul k a y}), ∃ c : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) H, ∀ j : Fin n, Coalgebra.comul (R := k) (b j : H) = ∑ i : Fin n, TensorProduct.tmul k (b i : H) (c i j)
